title: Model selection in hybrid quantum neural networks with applications to quantum transformer architectures
summary: Quantum machine learning models generally lack principled design guidelines, often requiring full resource-intensive training across numerous choices of encodings, quantum circuit designs and initialization strategies to find effective configuration. To address this challenge, we develope the Quantum Bias-Expressivity Toolbox ($\texttt{QBET}$), a framework for evaluating quantum, classical, and hybrid transformer architectures.
